script:
set -eu
unset LC_ALL
export LC_CTYPE=UTF-8

case "$selection" in
  *[![:space:]]*) ;;
  *)
    printf '%s\n' 'Text is empty' >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

printf '%s' "$selection" | /usr/bin/say -f -

en.name: Speak Text
en.description: Read the selected text aloud with the macOS system voice.

zh-CN.name: 朗读文本
zh-CN.description: 使用 macOS 系统语音朗读选中文本
